Provides a resource to create a DBDC db custom node.

> **NOTE:** Not all `zone` support configuration `systemDisk` and `dataDisks`. You can check the supported zone list with `tencentcloud.Dbdc.getDbCustomNodeTypes`.

## Example Usage

</span>

        <span class="property-type">string</span>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

    </dt>

Write-only: not returned by <code>DescribeDBCustomNodes</code>, so the configured value is preserved in state.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"

## Import



DBDC db custom node can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Dbdc/dbCustomNode:DbCustomNode example dbcn-ttiyh58n
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
